question: Which three gates were on the north side of the city?
options: The gates of Gad, Asher and Naphtali
The gates of Joseph, Benjamin and Dan
The gates of Simeon, Issachar and Zebulun
The gates of Reuben, Judah and Levi
explanation: On the north side, the three gates were the gate of Reuben, the gate of Judah and the gate of Levi.
